## Appearance

Robin is an attractive young man with a round skull covered in tiny, fuzzy, bright yellow ringlets. He has a snubbed nose and a single dimple in one cheek that gives him a sweet and amusing appearance when he chuckled.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P9](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0009), [v2 XXV An Brierley Scandal P71](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0071)_

## Personality

Robin Farrow is characterized as a mischievous, rascal-like youth who frequently pulls expressions and engages in trouble, such as incessantly tormenting cats. He possesses an active inquisitiveness and curiosity, often asking questions and desiring bloodthirsty stories, while also being described as a clever lad. Despite working with enthusiasm, he can be somewhat careless and prone to forgetting, though his troubles are easily comforted by plum jam. His ambitions include reaching one hundred years of age, becoming a shopkeeper to stock candy and bananas, visiting stone gods at the lighthouse, and gaining permission to attempt managing the farm in the upcoming year.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P30](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0030), [v2 IX A Question of Color P21](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0021), [v2 IX A Question of Color P22](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0022), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P31](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0031), +12 more_

## History

Robin Farrow, a former troublemaker, was brought to live at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) with his twin sister, [Lucy](../character/lucy.md), by [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) after becoming an orphan. Early on, he proved prone to mischief, such as tricking [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) into a pigpen and getting her wet under a water pump. He later locked [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) in Mr. Pettifer's toolhouse and broke down in tears when confronted, admitting he did not realize lying was wrong, which earned him a punishment of going to bed without dinner. His antics continued as he accidentally ruined lemon pies intended for guests and knocked over a shell that shattered a borrowed platter. Despite his antics, he bonded closely with [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md), seeking her comfort when he felt jealous of others or worried about her affections. Following the death of [Richard Farrow](../character/richard-farrow.md), a trust fund was established for Robin and [Lucy](../character/lucy.md), allowing them to permanently reside at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters). During a severe storm, Robin sheltered at home with the family as hail devastated the area. When [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) left for college, a distressed Robin questioned her departure, though he later sent her letters filled with local news and descriptions of his ongoing mischief. While [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) was away, Robin rebelled against Mrs. Sowerby's strict rules by throwing away collection money, forcing [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) to skip Sunday School, and telling lies, but he eventually confessed his guilt to [Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md). As time passed, he matured and attended Nell's orchard wedding to [Hugh Carrow](../character/hugh-carrow.md), later receiving an invitation from Captain Saul to visit him at the lighthouse during a festive [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) gathering.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P30](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0030), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P47](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0047), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), +59 more_

## Quotes

> "You do not seem like the kind of lady who would lash a small boy simply because he was unable to stay motionless. Did you not find staying motionless terribly difficult when you were merely as old as I am?"
>
> — Robin Farrow — [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P3](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0003)

> "Thirza did the laundry yesterday . . . and Mrs. Wiggins scrubbed my skin using hard soap on the funeral day. For a single week, that suffices. Being so exceedingly clean seems pointless to me. Staying dirty is far more comfortable."
>
> — Robin Farrow — [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P31](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0031)

> "However, the caterpillar was so amazingly large . . . I grabbed him from the church steps right as we entered. Wasting him appeared to be a shame. Also, tell me, was it not amusing listening to that girl scream?"
>
> — Robin Farrow — [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P43](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0043)

> "I only carried it out for amusement. Events have been extraordinarily quiet in this place for such a long time that I believed scaring you people immensely would prove entertaining. Indeed, it turned out to be so."
>
> — Robin Farrow — [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P43](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0043)

> “Why?” asked Robin, making himself comfortable and gazing upward with a tear-streaked, probing countenance. “Why is whopper not as good as falsehood? I want to know. It is an equally large word.”
>
> — Robin Farrow — [v2 X Robin in Search of a Sensation P58](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0058)

## Relationships

### [Lucy](../character/lucy.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lucy--robin-farrow.md)

[Lucy](../character/lucy.md) is Robin's twin sister, who comes to live at [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) alongside him after they are newly orphaned. Robin frequently targets her with energetic mischief and trickery, enticing her outside to get drenched under a water pump, convincing her to jump into a pigpen, and locking her inside Mr. Pettifer's toolhouse.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Thirza Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), +21 more_

### [Nell Harcourt](../character/nell-harcourt.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/nell-harcourt--robin-farrow.md)

[Nell](../character/nell-harcourt.md) acts as an affectionate guardian and friend to Robin, holding the authority to discipline and order him around while staying focused on how best to raise him. She routinely intervenes in his mischievous antics, comforting him when he breaks down over his misbehavior and defending family members when he challenges their rules.

### [Thirza Abernethy](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/robin-farrow--thirza-abernethy.md)

[Thirza](../character/thirza-abernethy.md) is Robin's third cousin once removed, who takes him into [Grey Shutters](../codex/places.md#grey-shutters) and serves as his guardian.
